sql:
SELECT
  t.name AS merchant_name,
  COUNT(*) AS tickets_2025,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tk.channel = 'email') / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_email,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tk.channel = 'chat') / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_chat,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tk.channel = 'phone') / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_phone,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tk.channel = 'web') / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_web,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tk.channel = 'social') / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_social,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tk.channel = 'api') / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_api
FROM tickets tk
JOIN tenants t ON t.id = tk.tenant_id
WHERE tk.created_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND tk.created_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY t.id, t.name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY tickets_2025 DESC, merchant_name ASC
LIMIT 50
note: Grain is one row per tenant; percentages are rounded to 1 decimal so they may sum to slightly off 100.0 due to rounding. The query caps at 50 rows as requested; the batch report framework will note the total row count returned.
